channel.title: Uptick
channel.description: Uptick explains the stories everyone is searching for, from breaking news and sports to tech, health and culture, in clear, sourced explainers updated as they change.

item.title: Pennsylvania Measles Outbreak Tops 1,200 Cases: What to Know
item.description: Pennsylvania’s measles outbreak has passed 1,200 cases, the state’s largest in decades. Symptoms, who’s at risk, and how to protect your family.

item.title: Strait of Hormuz Attacks: Why Ships Are Sinking and Why It Matters
item.description: Two cargo ships sank near the Strait of Hormuz this week as attacks on shipping surged. What happened, who says what, and why it hits fuel prices.

item.title: September CPI: Inflation Jumps to 3.7% as Gas Prices Soar
item.description: U.S. inflation rose to 3.7% in September as gasoline jumped 34% from a year ago. What drove it, what it means for paychecks, and the Fed’s next move.

item.title: TSMC Earnings: Record Q3 Profit Jumps 69% on AI Chip Demand
item.description: TSMC’s third-quarter profit rose 68.7% to a record NT$763 billion as AI demand outran supply. The key numbers, what’s driving them and the outlook.

item.title: Brewers Sweep Dodgers to Reach First World Series Since 1982
item.description: Milwaukee rallied from 4-0 down to finish a four-game NLCS sweep of the two-time champion Dodgers. How it happened and when the World Series starts.

item.title: DV Lottery 2027: Judge Orders the Green Card Lottery to Open
item.description: A federal judge ordered the State Department to run the DV-2027 green card lottery. The new dates, the catch for winners, and how to enter safely.
